projects.title: A Reproducible Decoder Laboratory
projects.description: Build an educational language-model laboratory with independent PyTorch and JAX implementations, carefully tested architectural extensions and a small set of controlled experiments. A reviewer can run the CPU smoke demonstration before inspecting the deeper training and inference evidence.
requirements: Tiny GPT-style and modern decoder implementations with causality, stable-loss and checkpoint tests.
Shared-weight PyTorch/JAX logits, loss and representative-gradient parity.
Cache/full-prefix equivalence, a matched GQA/MHA study and explicit cache-byte accounting.
A LoRA structured-task experiment with frozen base weights, merge checks and held-out outcomes.
A four-expert top-2 teaching MoE with output/gradient parity and routing diagnostics.
A bounded small-model training comparison, with equal-token interpretation and seed limitations.
Architecture notes that label implemented, code-traced and paper-only understanding.
One-command CPU smoke run, model/data cards, technical report, short explanation and contribution draft.
